principle: Deterministic, engine-free assignment of human-triaged real incidents to the tool's predicate-backed in-scope drift classes. This file is frozen before any bank build; it is auditable prose-regex only and never reads src/docassay. It decides exemplar CLASS membership, not whether an incident is a real defect (that is the triage source's job) and not what the injector finally mutates.

all_of: (no longer exists|no longer available|no longer at|moved|relocat|renamed|deleted|removed|at that path|new (location|path)|wrong (path|location)|stale (link|path))
path-location-drift.note: A path-shaped token AND a location-change predicate, unless the sentence is a symbol/field rename (\`code renamed it to ...\`) so those reach identifier-drift.

external-dependency-drift.note: Declared/external requirement language. Broad by construction; the injector only ever mutates a declared manifest entry, so noisy exemplars still anchor target selection.

removed-referent-drift.note: A removed/deleted referent (code symbol or documented element). Renames are excluded here and assigned to identifier-drift.

identifier-drift.note: A renamed identifier/referent. Placement last in precedence so path prefixes win on file renames. Present-tense 'renames it to' is included; an explicit none_of guard in path-location-drift keeps symbol/field renames out of the path class.
